_meta.change: split the cogPG.PG155 whole-volume CGPG dump into per-work corpus files
_meta.plan_basis: cgpg_zerocredit_identification.json PG155. The sixteen segments follow Migne's conventional treatise division (the standard citation form for Symeon); works 1-11 are parts of the one great dialogue, noted per work
_meta.shared_row_rule: a served row holding a work boundary is assigned to exactly one work, normally the one whose incipit the row carries; the plan records the decision as the ranges themselves
_meta.reversible: To revert: for every carved work file listed under 'works', drop its rows whose locus starts 'PG155.' (delete the file when it was 'created'), strip the 'PG155.' prefix from their loci, re-insert them and the archived 'dropped_duplicates' rows into data/corpus/cogPG.PG155.jsonl together with the residual rows, sorted by locus, and restore data/cgpg_works.json, data/tlg_crosswalk.json/.tsv, and data/corrections_log/provenance.json from the parent commit (or simply git revert the commit; old sha256 below verifies). Every moved row's text is byte-identical; only urn and locus changed.
